blocks.content: React Router is the standard routing library for React. We'll use version 6 for this course.
The core idea is simple: the URL is the source of truth. Here's how it works:

items: When the URL is /, show the home page.
When the URL is /entries/7, show that entry's detail page.

blocks.content: React Router reads the URL and decides which component to render — no page reload, no server round-trip.
Next, let's explore the various pieces of the router library that make all of this possible.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
